import pytest


def parity(x: int) -> bool:
    """True when the byte (an int from 0 to 255) has an odd number of set bits."""
    return bin(x).count("1") % 2 == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("x", "expected"),
    [
        (0, False),
        (1, True),
        (3, False),
        (7, True),
        (128, True),
        (255, False),
    ],
)
def test_parity(x: int, expected: bool) -> None:
    assert parity(x) is expected
